opening.argument: The presentation ties entry into the project to purchasing mining equipment, including a $3,599 Bitcoin robot and lower-priced robot parts, while directing viewers to the person who invited them. It presents rewards as generated and distributed through the machines, and claims that new investors buying machines increased mining power and distributions. A displayed page reinforces the sales structure with priced mining options and Buy Now controls, while the description calls the mining “100% Real and Verifiable” and invites participation. These paid packages are paired with promised Bitcoin rewards and claimed blockchain legitimacy, but the presentation does not establish that the service operated as described or that its rewards and claims were accurate.
